Practice areas describe the law we know. These are the ways we actually help — from a single written opinion to conduct of a matter from notice through to enforcement.
What We Offer
Eight ways to engage the firm
Every engagement begins with a written scope and a fee basis, so you know what you are buying before we begin.
Legal Consultation
A structured first opinion on where you stand. You leave the session knowing the legal position, the realistic outcomes, the likely timeline and what it will cost — in writing, whether or not you engage us further.
Written summary of position and options after the session
Candid view on merits, including when not to litigate
Fee estimate before any engagement begins
Available in person, by video call or by telephone
End-to-end conduct of your matter before trial courts, tribunals, District Courts and the High Court — pleadings, evidence, arguments and execution, handled by the advocate who briefed you.
Written update after every listed hearing
Continuity of counsel — no unexplained substitutions
Interim relief pursued early where assets are at risk
Agreements, deeds, petitions, replies and settlements drafted from scratch for your facts. We do not adapt templates and hope for the best — clauses are written to hold when they are tested.
Bespoke drafting, never recycled boilerplate
Plain-language explanation of every operative clause
Two rounds of revision included as standard
Registration and stamping handled where applicable
A properly drafted notice resolves a surprising share of disputes without litigation, and strengthens your record if it does not. We also draft measured replies to notices you have received.
Drafted and dispatched typically within 48 hours
Sent by registered post and email with proof of service
Title searches, corporate diligence and transaction opinions that tell you what you are actually buying — including the defects that cannot be cured and the risks worth walking away from.
Written opinion stating risk plainly, not hedged into uselessness
Defects separated into curable and non-curable
Direct advice on whether to proceed or renegotiate
Turnaround agreed in advance to suit your deal timeline
Retainer advisory that keeps a business on the right side of company, tax and data protection obligations, with a calendar so filings and renewals never lapse unnoticed.
Annual compliance calendar with owner and due date per item
Monthly retainer covering routine queries without per-hour billing
Policy and contract templates maintained as the law changes
Escalation path to litigation counsel within the same firm
Company and LLP incorporation, property registration, GST registration and society formation — handled as a managed process with status visibility, not a black box.
Document checklist provided upfront so nothing stalls midway
Government fees stated separately from professional fees
Status updates at each stage of the filing
Objections and examination reports handled without extra charge
Video and telephone consultation for clients outside the city or abroad, with documents exchanged securely and powers of attorney arranged so you need not travel for routine appearances.
Appointments scheduled across time zones
Secure document exchange and e-signature where permitted
Power of attorney and vakalatnama arranged remotely
Experience with NRI property, divorce and succession matters
